captions: Click a step in the list: the entrance
A boss: the view centres on it
A move step: that stretch of the route
The next stretch, one click away
The last boss: one click per step
Run mode follows your plan step by step
Next: the next stretch of the route
Next again: the map behind it moves on
Your own copy: pick the Route tool
Click the map to add a bend; Shift-click makes a numbered stop
The route shows up as steps for run mode
Type "forever" to see Forever's new dungeons
Or a few letters of a name
Narrow it down to one dungeon
